question: If 20 percent of a number is added to 60, the result is that number. 70 percent of that number is ................
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

0.2x + 60 = x

0.8x = 60 ⇒ x = 75

70% of x = 0.7 × 75

= 52.5

**∴ Answer = 52.5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of a number when added to 60 gives the number

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (value ÷ 100) × number

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the number be x

⇒ 20% of x = (20/100) × x = 0.2x

⇒ According to question

⇒ 0.2x + 60 = x

⇒ x − 0.2x = 60

⇒ 0.8x = 60

⇒ x = 60 ÷ 0.8 = 75

⇒ Required percentage = 70% of 75

⇒ = (70/100) × 75

⇒ = 52.5

**∴ The correct answer is 52.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Formula

x% of number = (x/100) × number

Equation Formation

Translate statement into linear equation

Decimal Conversion

20% = 0.2, 70% = 0.7
